_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. All paths accept ~. No secrets belong here.
_python_envs_comment: empty = the python running secbrief. Add interpreters to scan other venvs, e.g. ["/opt/myapp/venv/bin/python"]
_deb_hosts_comment: Ubuntu/Debian machines reachable by SSH key. e.g. [{"name": "server1", "user": "me"}]. Matching runs dpkg on the host; distro advisories (OSV Ubuntu/Debian entries) are the truth for these.
_brew_watch_comment: macOS only. Homebrew has no CVE database, so these are reported as version drift (更新遅れ), not CVE findings.
_accepted_comment: Items you reviewed and accept: [{"advisory_id": "OSV-...", "package": "libfoo", "version": "1.2.3"}]. Suppressed from alerts, still shown in the briefing with (accepted). Auto-unaccepted if the CVE enters CISA KEV.
_ignore_overrides_comment: Owner-asserted 'no input path' for a package+advisory: [{"advisory_id": "...", "package": "..."}]. The machine never decides this for you.
